name: Windows Vista Sidebar
author: ocko
description: The Windows Vista Sidebar on the right edge of the desktop with the Clock, CPU Meter, Slide Show and Weather gadgets. Off until switched on (Start menu > All Programs > Windows Sidebar, or omarchy-shell vistasidebar toggle); no timers run while it is hidden. Enabled only while a Vista theme is active (omarchy/vista/bin/vista-mode).
